description.zh: 在侧栏一键切换 Harness，直接使用 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以回到普通对话。选中后立即换成对应主题，下一次新建的会话自动使用对应专家，并带上各自的会话界面。
description.en: Switch Harness in one click from the sidebar and use Claude Code or Codex, or return to normal chat. The matching theme appears immediately, and the next new session runs on that expert with its own conversation view.

details.zh:
## 一键切换 Harness

侧栏底部可以在「普通对话 / Claude / Codex」之间一键切换。欢迎页还没有会话时也能选。

这次选择决定下一次新建会话使用哪套 Harness。已经打开、已经绑定的会话保持原来的 Harness。

- 选 Claude：使用 Claude Code。
- 选 Codex：使用 Codex。
- 选普通对话：回到 JiuwenSwarm 原生对话。

## 选中后立刻生效

- 主题马上切换。Claude 是暖色纸面，Codex 是浅色底；回到普通对话后恢复原来的外观。
- 新建会话的第一条消息自动使用对应专家，无需再手动指定。已经指定过专家、或已经发过消息的会话保持原样。
- 刷新或重新打开已绑定的会话时，主题和 Harness 会恢复。

## 各自的会话界面

绑定到 Claude 或 Codex 之后，会话会带上对应界面：

- Claude：输入区状态、标题标识、等宽工具流，以及右侧沙箱面板。
- Codex：输入区状态、标题标识，以及回复下方的变更摘要。
- 普通对话：这些 Harness 专属界面会收起。

## 自带专家

安装后自带两个固定专家，切换时直接使用：

- Claude Code 专家
- Codex 专家

同名且类型匹配的专家会保留。若该专家已被别的 Harness 占用，则不覆盖，切换入口仍然可用。卸载后，这两个专家和历史会话绑定仍保留。

本包不安装 Claude Code 或 Codex 命令行，也不管理登录凭据。一次导入即可同时装上切换、主题和会话界面。
details.en:
## One-click Harness switch

The sidebar footer switches among Normal, Claude, and Codex in one click. It works on the welcome view before any session exists.

The choice applies to the next new session. A session that is already open and bound keeps its current Harness.

- Claude uses Claude Code.
- Codex uses Codex.
- Normal returns to native JiuwenSwarm chat.

## What happens when you switch

- The theme changes immediately. Claude uses a warm paper look, Codex uses a light look, and Normal restores the original appearance.
- The first message of a new session uses the matching expert automatically. Sessions that already have an expert, or that have already sent a message, stay as they are.
- Reloading or reopening a bound session restores its theme and Harness.

## Conversation views

A session bound to Claude or Codex gets its own view:

- Claude: composer status, a title mark, a monospace tool stream, and a sandbox panel on the right.
- Codex: composer status, a title mark, and a change summary under the reply.
- Normal chat puts this Harness-only view away.

## Built-in experts

Two fixed experts are ready to use as soon as the bundle is installed:

- Claude Code expert
- Codex expert

An existing expert with the same name and the same Harness type is kept. If that id is already used by a different Harness, it is left unchanged and the switch stays available. Uninstalling keeps both experts and existing session bindings.

This bundle does not install the Claude Code or Codex CLI and does not manage sign-in. One import installs the switch, the themes, and the conversation views together.
